notes: The shared cloud/thought-bubble mode, SVG outline, circular tails and Thinking labels were removed. All player and Alex messages use the original ordinary speech-bubble style, including Level 1. Player names and typing accessibility remain correct.

Level 3 teacher lines now address Alex and ask concrete questions. Alex retains two short replies per workbench beat that answer the question and add detail; metric names in his first uneven response follow the actual effort categories with singular/plural agreement. All 25 authored emoji remain distinct.

Level 3 action footers no longer show left-side explanatory captions, including the Choose any three helper, publication-ready caption, confirmation counter and comparison caption. Necessary selection feedback lives beside the priorities list; unchanged-split validation appears above the editor. Replay scene and Reset weights remain working controls.

The result effort-summary box, per-comparison-card summary footnotes and redundant comparison summary panel were removed. The three evidence rows, two actual player attempts and optional system reference remain fully visible.

Result/comparison typography is composed for balance rather than identical sizes across contexts: 22px readable sans-serif percentages, 16px medium-weight effort labels, slimmer bars, 16px main metric labels and 15px compact metric labels. Aligned headings and subtle dividers remain. Desktop and mobile screenshots were visually reviewed.

The user’s exact Focus/Reflection/Peer response example was also played through 67/17/16, 45/34/21 and the equal reference, confirming all three complete cards without repeated summary text or overflow.

All 20 priority trios, free second-attempt routes, both kinds of reference test, complete snapshots, name/sound/selection handoffs, real-time sequencing/audio, hidden-page holds, storage/no-audio fallbacks and 320–1366px layouts passed. No player Restart controls or administrator login were added.

The inclusive 10-point near-even range, editable original Level 2 trio, linked final-pair confirmation and manual Observe flow are unchanged. The final theory placeholder remains the endpoint; no Design Lab transition or completion page is present.

All four current entries and the two-version review ZIP were rebuilt together. Release checks verified all hashes and byte equality and played the individual and combined HTMLs. The review ZIP contains Level3/Level3.html and Full-game/Gaming-the-System.html from those exact tested builds.

Managed Chromium uses an in-memory HTTPS origin for exact offline production bytes because local file navigation is blocked. Direct file opening in the user browser, classroom load capacity and finished partner videos were not tested. Earlier validation reports remain historical.
